newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST ENGLAND.

text.p: Zimbabwe won the toss and chose to bat on the opening day of the first test against England at Queen's Club on Wednesday.
Zimbabwe - Alistair Campbell (captain), Grant Flower, Stuart Carlisle, Andy Waller, Dave Houghton, Andy Flower, Guy Whittall, Paul Strang, Heath Streak, Bryan Strang, Henry Olonga.
England - Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Graham Thorpe, Nasser Hussain, John Crawley, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Alan Mullally, Chris Silverwood, Phil Tufnell.
